column1: # MANUALLY MANAGED - semantic WIP identities for all carveable non-vendored functions.
# Address-only func_ names are unresolved; candidate signatures require caller/callee review.
# Methods use name=owner_action with the owner and action columns populated.
# Future analysis writes build/function-inventory proposals and never overwrites this file.

column11: note
loads and executes OPEN, GAME and END by index
GNU C 2.60 emits jal __main only in main; heap, CdInit, PadInit, InitCARD, then the game loop
Clears and initialises game state, runs one frame per pass until DAT_8009c3f8 is set, then shuts down and writes PSX.EXE's next-program byte (OPEN or END).
Shuts down audio and the CD events, stops pads and resets the GPU before leaving GAME.EXE.
libsnd start-up (tick mode, reverb, serial attr) and reset of the sound state: VAB banks, voice records, VAB stream slots and their buffers.
Opens and plays the background sequence (BGM volume from the player record) when BGM is on and the sequence and its VAB are ready.
Stops and closes the background sequence if it is playing.
Mutes, stops the sequence, closes every open VAB and calls SsEnd.
Plays a sound effect at a world position: distance falloff against the listener, stereo pan from the listener yaw; returns 1 if played. Pan formula differs from KF2 and the third argument is unused.
audio_play_spatial with the default range 0x5000 / falloff 0x4800.
Pass-through to audio_play_spatial with caller range and falloff.
Stores the listener position (and samples its map-cell layer) and the listener rotation, each if non-null.
Non-positional sound effect: audio_key_on with equal left/right volume and no note offset.
Keys on a sound effect's VAB program/tone with SE volume scaling and note offset if an SPU voice is free. KF3 drops KF2's voice-handle bookkeeping.
CD callback of a VAB read: checks the header sectors, opens the VAB head, then queues the body chunks (state 1 -> 2).
Per frame: if the current CD request is a VAB body chunk that has arrived, transfers it to SPU and asks for the next chunk or finishes the request.
Returns a free VAB buffer slot in the given slot range, else reclaims a state-2 slot (closing the VAB in the given bank range that uses it); NULL if none. KF3 takes the ranges as arguments.
Picks the buffer slot and SPU address for VAB bank INDEX and queues the archive entry's VAB read with audio_vab_stream_callback.
Steps a 12-bit angle toward a target by STEP the short way round, clamping at the target.
Steps a value toward a target by STEP (sign of STEP selects direction), clamping at the target.
SVECTOR = (TO - FROM) scaled to length LENGTH.
Accelerates an angular speed toward a target angle and applies drag; returns the remaining angle once within tolerance.
XZ forward vector of a yaw: (-sin, cos).
Copies a MATRIX turned by 0..3 quarter turns about Y.
Copies an SVECTOR turned by 0..3 quarter turns about Y. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Builds a rotation matrix about X.
Builds a rotation matrix about Y.
Builds a rotation matrix about Z.
MATRIX = Ry * Rx * Rz from an SVECTOR of angles.
MATRIX = Rx * Rz * Ry. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Unit forward SVECTOR for a pitch (vx) and yaw (vy).
Rotates an SVECTOR by YXZ angles into a VECTOR.
Scales a two-int vector by SCALE >> 11.
Scales an SVECTOR by SCALE >> 12.
Scales a two-int vector by SCALE >> 12. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
initial static signature seed; requires call-site review
Adds an XZ delta to a VECTOR. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
1 if two angles are within RANGE of each other (wrapping).
1 if (angle - target) mod 4096 <= half a turn.
1 if ANGLE > TARGET with both read as signed angles in -0x800..0x7ff. No KF2 counterpart (new in KF3).
Signed shortest turn from ANGLE to TARGET (-0x7ff..0x800).
Yaw of an XZ displacement in 4096ths of a turn.
Length of a 2D vector (components >> 3 to avoid overflow).
Length of a 3D vector (components >> 3).
Pitch and yaw (roll 0) of a 3D displacement.
1 if two directed 1D intervals overlap.

Horizontal distance from POS to a point if the point lies inside the rectangle +-half_width/+-half_depth turned by ROTATION's yaw around POS and within the vertical reach (y 0xffff skips it); else -1. No KF2 counterpart.
XZ distance from POS to a point if within RADIUS (box then circle) and the vertical reach; else -1.
Gap between two spheres (radius_a + radius_b reach, height-centred): distance - radius_b, 0 if overlapping, -9999999 if out of reach.
(rand() + rand()) * RANGE >> 15: triangular random 0..RANGE.
Triangular random centred on 0: (rand() + rand() - 32768) * RANGE >> 15.
Linear interpolation with a 4.12 fraction.
Angle interpolation the short way round with a 4.12 fraction.
Interpolates nine halfwords (a 3x3 matrix) with a 4.12 fraction.
Ballistic solver: flight time and launch angle for a horizontal/vertical distance, gravity and speed (higher or lower arc); -1 if unreachable.
Solves the trajectory between two points and returns time and horizontal/vertical speed components.
OUT = BASE + DIR * SCALE.

Empty body: fills all 32 slots of the default FDAT handler table the area loader installs while a module loads.

Opens the nine COM archives, loads FDAT entry 0x61 into the arena and copies its tables out (Object44 and Object4c records, sound effect params, TMD sets, ...), queues FDAT entry 0x60 as an image stream and VAB bank 0.
Requests a full reload of every area part and steps the loader (yielding to CD) until it finishes, then calls handler slot 5.
Shifts the player and every live Object4c, Object44, Object88 and placed-model record (DAT_80182968) by (dx, dy, dz). KF3 adds the placed-model list.
Asks for an area load (FDAT module, model set, image, VAB, sequence, origin shift; 0xff keeps a part, 200 only restarts the sequence), waiting out a load already running.
CD callback: area loader step = 1 (FDAT map entry read).
CD callback: area loader step = 2 (FDAT module read).
CD callback: area loader step = 3 (object placement entry read).
CD callback: area loader step = 4 (RTMD model set read).
CD callback: area loader step = 6 (sequence read).
The area loader's step machine: FDAT map + handler module, object placements, model set, image, BGM fade, VAB and sequence; commits the new part ids when done.
CD callback of an image stream part: marks the part ready (state 1).
Queues an archive entry as a chunked VRAM image stream into the stream work buffer (used for RTIM area images and FDAT entry 0x60).
Sets the next part's sector count to at most 16 and decrements the sectors remaining.
Per frame: uploads the image records in the arrived part with LoadImage (splitting a record across parts), restarts on a bad header, asks for the next part or finishes.
Copies COUNT words; returns the source end.
Copies COUNT halfwords; returns the source end.
Fills COUNT words with VALUE; returns the destination end.
Fills COUNT halfwords with VALUE. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Merges the free blocks that follow BLOCK into it.
Marks a block free and clears its owner's pointer.
First free block of SIZE, else frees and merges a long enough run of cached blocks; NULL if none.
Waits on the CD queue while any block is still loading.
Frees cached blocks, slides used blocks down (updating owners) and leaves one free block at the end.
Formats an arena as one free block plus an end marker.
Allocates SIZE from an arena (compacting once if needed), splits off a remainder of 2060+ bytes, records the owner pointer.
memory_arena_free on the block header of a data pointer.
Sets the state byte (free/cached/used/loading) of a data pointer's block.
Returns the state byte of a data pointer's block.
Sets header byte 1 of a data pointer's block. Uncalled; 'flags' is KF2's field word, unproven in KF3.
Returns header byte 1 of a data pointer's block. Uncalled; 'flags' is KF2's field word, unproven in KF3.
Sets the halfword at header +2 of a data pointer's block; callers store model/resource ids.
Returns the halfword tag at header +2. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
malloc, NULL unless the result lies in main RAM.
memory_malloc_checked of SIZE rounded up to a word.
free() wrapper.
Services the VAB and image requests at the head of the CD queue, then waits two VSyncs.
VSync root-counter event handler: counts frames and the frame-gate counter, and adds a play-time minute every 3600 frames (KF3 addition).
Frame pacing: waits until at least four VSyncs have passed since the last call, then resets the counter (15 Hz). KF2's version waits for two.
Frees the finished request, moves the ring's read pointer on and seeks to the next request or pauses the drive.
CD command-complete event handler: starts the read after a seek, checksums whole reads and runs the request callback.
CD data-ready event handler for sector-callback requests: copies one sector, runs the callback, advances when done.
Empty CD error event handler.
BCD byte to integer.
Integer to BCD byte.
Absolute sector number of a BCD CdlLOC (no 150-sector lead-in).
BCD CdlLOC of an absolute sector number.
CdlLOC plus a sector offset.
Yields frames until the CD request ring is empty.
Yields frames until a request slot is free.
Nonzero unless the last word equals 0x12345678 plus the sum of the preceding words.
Fills the ring's write slot (kind, position, buffer, sector count, callback), advances it and seeks if the request is current.
Byte size of archive entry ENTRY and (optionally) its CdlLOC.
Queues a checksummed whole read (kind 0x10) of an archive entry.
Queues a sector-by-sector callback read (CdRead2 + data-ready handler) of an archive entry. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Queues an archive entry as a VAB read request (kind 0x30) whose callback steps the VAB load.
Queues an archive entry as an image stream read in 16-sector parts.
Byte size of archive entry ENTRY.
Empty CD error hook (called on read failure and CdSearchFile failure).
Synchronous sector read with the queue idle and the CD events disabled, three tries.
Allocates a sector-rounded buffer and reads a file extent into it. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Reads BYTES of an extent (all of it if 0) into a buffer.
Reads an archive entry synchronously until its checksum holds.
Loads \CD\<name>;1 into a fresh allocation. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Loads BYTES (all if 0) of \CD\<name>;1 into a buffer. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
Opens \CD\<name>;1 as archive slot INDEX: keeps its extent and copies the sector-offset table from sector 0.
Opens the VSync counter event and the CD error/complete/data-ready events and clears the 24-entry request ring.
Closes the four events cd_initialize opened.
